# Libra Studio Architects

Libra Studio Architects is a Interior Design company. LibraStudioArchitects is a company that specializes in interior design, architecture, and decoration. They offer services for building construction, tours, and case-study. The company is focused on providing beautiful and beautiful architecture experiences to its clients. Libra Studio Architects employs 2 people. Headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India.

## About

Libra Studio is a young architecture initiative to create habitable spaces which respond to the context and bring a better living condition in the society.
Libra deals with every kind of architecture, landscape, urban and interior projects.
Libra also tries to get in touch with the developing technology by bringing Virtual Reality to the architecture and interior field.
Sustainability, design oriented, aesthetics, research, conceptual and advancement with respect to materials and techniques forms the core of Libra.
